name: gap_fill_partial_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY gap-up or gap-down days of 0.4-1.2% (roughly 36-108 spot points), short-term gap traders who positioned at the open begin profit-taking as price approaches the half-gap level — the exact midpoint between today's open and yesterday's close. This midpoint acts as an intraday support/resistance magnet because retail and semi-algorithmic traders anchor their 'give back 50%' exit rules there, clustering limit orders at that price. At 5-second resolution, the first EMA(12) cross of EMA(36) in the fill direction — before the half-gap is reached — marks the onset of this profit-taking flow and offers a 15-90 second directional window of 8-12 NIFTY spot points.
core_signal_oneliner: Gap 0.4-1.2% day: first EMA(12) cross of EMA(36) in the fill direction while price has not yet reached the halfway midpoint between open and prev close
